violations.text: Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The hand-washing sink in the dining area was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
Inspector observed container of insecticide chemicals. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

(1 Dr Reach in ) located in the (kitchen ) area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures observed at 43-44DF.Per PIC, refrigeration is not in use and waiting on technician to finish repairing. There was no food storage in unit at time of inspection. PIC informed to continue not placing TCS food sin unit until completely repaired and/or replaced. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The floors in the 3 bay sink area is in poor repair. Observed tiles detaching from floor. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/24/2026

The floors in the kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Bottle of chemical, a bowl, and sponges were observed in the kitchen hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Items removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (cooked foods) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
Sanitizer was not available at the time of inspection. PIC obtained chlorine sanitizer during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Several food items were observed held at 56-58 degrees Fahrenheit in the refrigerator, with an ambient temperature of 58. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All foods requiring refrigeration were disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration units. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
Refrigerator in the kitchen was in poor repair, not maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees F or below. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of spider webs and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the kitchen area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as designer sauce) in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service during time of inspection. Ice machine cannot be used until equipment is cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2024

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 02/26/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 02/26/2024
The floors under the 3 bay sink is in poor repair. Hole observed in dry storage room. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2024
